*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ID consult - ESBL UTI.
84F (55.4 kg), CKD 5D on HD TTS at East unit (dialyzed today), admitted 1/27 c/o fever, dysuria, suprapubic pain. Urine cx 1/30: E. coli (ESBL) - CTX R, FEP R, TZP I, cipro R; ertapenem S, meropenem S. Blood cx 1/25 no growth.

Day 4 of ceftriaxone 1 g q24h w/o improvement - Tmax 38.4, suprapubic tenderness persists, CRP 80 and climbing since admission. WBC 7.6. Hemodynamically stable: MAPs 70s-80s off any pressors, no vasopressor requirement at any point this stay, lactate 1.0, no signs of shock. Source: indwelling foley (presumed nidus) exchanged 1/29; bedside US s/p exchange shows no abscess, no obstruction - source considered controlled.

Allergies: EHR lists vancomycin (red man, moderate) only. Daughter at bedside reports pt had anaphylaxis to penicillin yrs ago (throat swelling, hospitalized) - never entered in chart; pharmacy paged to add. Avoid PCN class given this hx.

(copied fwd from 1/28): 'T 37.6 HR 78 BP 122/70, afebrile this AM. Plan: cont CTX, await cx.' NB: vitals/plan above are stale - fevers recurred and cx is now back w/ ESBL R to CTX; the CTX course has failed.

Plan:
- Meropenem 1 g IV q24h, give post-HD on dialysis days; restricted-abx exception form submitted.
- Ertapenem S but not stocked at unit pharmacy.
- F/u CRP in 48h; cont HD TTS, K 4.5 today.
- Hgb 11.6 stable, cont EPO per unit protocol. Pt denies rash, pruritus, diarrhea.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
1/27 progress: 42M w/ CKD 3a admitted 1/26 w/ fever to 38.7 at home + dysuria x3d. Now T 38.2, HR 101, BP 124/72 (MAP 89), RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Warm, well perfused, no vasopressors, no signs of shock. Lactate 0.9. WBC 13.6, CRP 60, Cr 2.0 (near baseline per prior labs), K 3.9, Hgb 8.5 stable. UA +LE; urine cx from 1/26 growing E. faecalis, amp S / vanc S per micro. Blood cx x2 drawn, pending. Pt voiding fine, eating, denies CP/cough. c/o poor sleep d/t roommate snoring. A/P: febrile UTI vs early pyelo — start empiric vanc + ceftriaxone this AM, tailor once cx finalize. IVF 75/hr. NKDA. Recheck BMP in AM; nephro consulted for abx dosing w/ CKD. f/u blood cx.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
Nephro consult 1/29 — asked re: abx dosing in CKD. 42M, 98.9 kg, CKD 3a (baseline Cr ~1.7-1.8, eGFR ~48), Cr now 2.0 and stable, UOP adequate, no indication for HD at this time. On vanc 1g IV q24h (started 1/28) + ceftriaxone for febrile UTI; urine cx E. faecalis, amp/vanc S. Remains hemodynamically stable: BP 128/76, MAP 93, off pressors since arrival, lactate 0.9 on last check. No edema, lungs CTA, JVP not elevated. Pt ambulating w/ PT, watching the game, in good spirits. Recs: cont vanc 1000 mg IV q24h, draw trough pre-4th dose (1/31 AM); given stable renal fcn current regimen reasonable, adjust per level. Recheck Cr q48h, avoid NSAIDs/contrast, continue gentle IVF. NKDA. Recs discussed w/ primary team; will f/u trough result.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
2/1 progress: (copied fwd from 1/27) Vitals: T 38.2, HR 101, BP 124/72 MAP 89, RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Plan: blood cx x2, empiric abx pending cx, IVF 75/hr. — end copied block. Update 2/1 (supersedes copied vitals/plan above): T 37.9 this AM after 38.3 spike overnight, HR 88, BP 132/80 (MAP 97) on RA. Remains off pressors, no hypoperfusion, no signs of shock; lactate not repeated given stability. Vanc trough 1/31 = 13.0 on 1g q24h; Cr 2.0, eGFR 48, K 3.9, Hgb 8.5 stable, no transfusion. Blood cx still pending. Urine cx E. faecalis amp S — de-escalation discussed at rounds, but pt still spiking and team prefers to hold current coverage until blood cx final. Restricted-abx exception form submitted today to continue vanc. Pt ate breakfast, asks re: discharge — likely a few more days. NKDA.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
Hospital day 3, fever of unclear source. 80F, 55.3 kg, hx CKD 3a, HTN. T max 38.6 overnight, currently 38.1. BP 130/76 (MAP 94), HR 86, RR 18, SpO2 96% RA. Hemodynamically stable — no vasopressor support at any point this admission, lactate 1.7, no signs of shock. Lungs CTA bilat, no rash, no line erythema, chronic mild bipedal edema. Pt c/o fatigue, poor appetite; denies chest pain, denies SOB, denies dysuria (again denies CP/SOB on repeat questioning). WBC 9.9, CRP markedly elevated. No cultures sent yet this admission — will order blood and urine cx today. Severe PCN allergy (angioedema) per pt and daughter — avoiding beta-lactams; empiric vanc continued for MRSA coverage. Also latex allergy, mild contact dermatitis — latex-free cart flagged. Chart review back to 2019: no documented MRSA, VRE, ESBL, or CRE colonization or infection; never on MDRO precautions. Renal diet ordered; daughter brings snacks — counseled on low-K choices (pt loves bananas, asked to limit). Son handles transport, car unreliable — missed two clinic appts in Dec. Family meeting w/ daughter tomorrow re: disposition. Cont plan, f/u labs.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
Nephrology f/u. 80F w/ CKD 3a, admitted w/ fever, on empiric vanc 1000 mg IV q8h x4 days (severe PCN allergy — angioedema; latex contact dermatitis also on list). Exception form filed today to continue vanc; no culture data available to date, team still to send blood/urine cx. Vanc trough 18.7 (goal 15-20) — at 55.3 kg and eGFR 50 will ask pharmacy to dose, likely space to q12h, recheck level. Vitals: T 37.9, BP 126/72 (MAP 90), HR 82. Remains off all pressors, no hypotension at any point this admission, lactate 1.7 — no signs of shock. Cr 1.68 at baseline, K 5.8 — cont low-K diet, lisinopril held since admission, will add potassium binder if persistent. Hgb 9.6 stable, no transfusion. WBC 9.9, CRP 224. PO4 4.8 — sevelamer 800 mg PO w/ meals continued. PTH 118, stable, recheck in 3 mo outpatient. Not on dialysis, no HD access. Pt feels better, denies chills, denies CP/SOB, appetite improving. Daughter at bedside, plan reviewed. Transport still an issue — son's car in shop, SW consulted for ride voucher to f/u at Synthetic Dialysis Unit East. Monitor renal fn and vanc levels.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
75F w/ ESRD on CAPD (4 exch/day at home), HTN, T2DM — admit 2/4 c/o 2d fever, rigors, confusion per daughter. T 38.9, HR 118, BP 84/46 (MAP ~58) after 30 mL/kg LR in ED; norepi started, now 0.12 mcg/kg/min, MAPs 66-70 overnight. Lactate 4.9. WBC 16.7, CRP 216. Blood cx 2/1 (from PD clinic): no growth. Empiric vanc 2g x1 + pip-tazo given; ID to f/u. PD exchanges held while on pressors. O2 3L NC, sat 95%. Exam: lethargic but arouses; PD catheter exit site clean, no erythema or drainage; abdomen soft, nonperitoneal. Chronic R forearm AVF w/ faint thrill, never cannulated. Allergies: latex (mild contact dermatitis) — latex-free supplies. Plan: cont norepi titrate MAP >=65, judicious fluids given ESRD, recheck lactate q6h, NPO for now, renal diet when advanced. DVT ppx: SCDs only. Daughter at bedside; family meeting re: goals of care planned today — remains full code. PT/OT consulted.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
75F, CKD 5D on PD (CAPD 4 exch/day via Synthetic Home Dialysis Program), ICU day 4 for septic shock. Still on norepi 0.08 mcg/kg/min this AM to keep MAP >=65 — overnight BPs 88-96/50s on pressors, not yet weaned. Lactate 4.9 on last gas; WBC 16.7, CRP 216. Urine cx 2/6: E. coli — S to ceftriaxone, pip-tazo, meropenem; ID narrowing the non-vanc agent. Blood cx 2/1 no growth. Vanc trough 14.8 — renally cleared; exception request in for vanc 2g IV q5d w/ level-guided redosing. Relevant hx: MRSA exit-site infection of PD catheter in 2024, s/p vanc course, resolved; +MRSA nares swab same yr — supports cont empiric gram-positive coverage this admission. Cr 9.94, eGFR 7, K 4.6, Hgb 9.4 (at baseline, on EPO at clinic). PD held during pressors; resume 2 short exchanges when weaned, no net UF while hypotensive. Last iPTH in 780s — cont cinacalcet 30 mg daily; sevelamer 800 TID held while NPO, restart w/ diet. RD: renal diet, 2g Na, fluid <1.5L once eating. SW f/u — daughter reports transport to home dialysis clinic difficult since husband fell ill. Family meeting w/ ICU team this pm. Latex allergy (contact dermatitis) — latex-free gloves for exchanges.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
40M, CKD 5D on HD (TTS), sent in from dialysis unit Tue w/ fever 38.9, rigors, malaise x2d. Denies cough, dysuria, abd pain, CP, SOB. No recent travel, no sick contacts. Allergy: ampicillin (anaphylaxis) — flagged in chart, avoid PCN class. Vitals on arrival: T 38.7, HR 104, BP 102/61, RR 20, SpO2 97% RA. Labs: WBC 18.9, Cr 13.12, eGFR 5, K 3.8, Hgb 8.9, lactate 1.9. No cultures sent; treating empirically. Started cefepime 1 g IV q24h, renally dosed, give after HD sessions. Cautious w/ IVF given ESRD — euvolemic on exam, no bolus for now. Pt c/o chills x1 in ED, resolved. HD to resume Thu per TTS schedule. Wife at bedside, agrees w/ plan. Plan: empiric abx, trend WBC/lactate AM, strict I/O, f/u in AM.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
40M CKD5D (HD TTS), admitted 2/4 w/ fever, transferred to ICU overnight for hypotension. (copied fwd from 2/6) VS: T 37.4, HR 96, BP 118/72, RR 18, SpO2 98% RA, off vasopressors. A/P: cont cefepime, monitor on floor, HD per schedule. — NB: above copied VS/plan are stale, superseded by events below; pt decompensated overnight. 0230: persistent hypotension, BP 82/46 despite ~30 cc/kg LR. Norepi started, now 0.14 mcg/kg/min, MAP 66 — pressor required to hold MAP >=65 despite fluids. Day 4 of cefepime w/ no improvement: WBC 18.9 -> 22.4, still febrile 39.2, lactate up to 4.0. Remains on cefepime pending pharmacy review for broader gram-negative coverage — restricted-form drug, paperwork in progress. K 3.9, Hgb 8.7 stable, no transfusion. Cr 13.1, eGFR 5, HD done Sat, next session Tue per TTS — coordinate timing w/ nephro. A&Ox3 when off propofol breaks. Family updated by phone. No cultures on file to date.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
40M, CKD 5D on HD (TTS — due today), ICU day 2+. Still septic: on norepi 0.14-0.18 overnight to keep MAP >=65 despite fluids, currently MAP 63-68 on 0.16. Now >120h (5 d) of cefepime w/ clear clinical worsening — WBC 23.7, CRP 62, lactate 4.2, persistent fevers to 39.4. K 3.9, Hgb 8.7, Cr 13.12, eGFR 5. Ampicillin anaphylaxis re-confirmed w/ wife, allergy band on. Given failure of first-line agent w/ ongoing pressor-dependent sepsis, submitted restricted-antimicrobial exception for meropenem 500 mg IV q24h, HD-adjusted — will dose after today's session. No cultures sent to date, remains empiric. Strict I/O, f/u lactate q4h, f/u WBC AM. Will reassess pressor wean once on appropriate coverage. Pt's wife updated, understands plan.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ID consult f/u — 81M, ESRD on HD TTS (Synthetic Kidney Clinic North), seen at HD unit for VRE in urine. Urine cx 2/11: Enterococcus faecium, vanc-resistant (VRE) — vanc R, amp R, linezolid S, dapto S. Pt c/o 2d suprapubic discomfort and frequency; denies flank pain, denies N/V. T max 38.1 at unit, HR 88, BP stable on run, lactate 0.9 — no signs of shock, not septic. WBC 14.5, CRP 160. Assessment: VRE UTI (cystitis vs early pyelo). Source is urinary, NOT pulmonary — no cough, no sputum, denies dyspnea; CXR 2/12 w/o infiltrate or consolidation, lungs CTA bilat. Pneumonia not on the ddx at this time. Ampicillin anaphylaxis hx on file, moot anyway (amp R). Plan: daptomycin 600 mg IV after each HD (~6 mg/kg, wt 100.1 kg); restricted-abx exception form sent to pharmacy. Linezolid S but deferring — anticipated 10-14 d course, baseline Hgb 9.2, prefer to avoid marrow suppression. Baseline CK 98; weekly CK, counsel on myalgias. Repeat urine cx in 48-72h. Pt's ride arrived late, session shortened ~30 min — asked unit clerk to help coordinate; does not change abx plan. Will f/u.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
HD note (Sat run) — 81M, CKD 5D, HD TTS via L forearm AVF; bruit +, thrill +, no erythema or drainage, needle sites clean. Run: 3.5 h, UF 2.1 L, QB 400, pre BP 142/74, post 128/66, tolerated w/o cramping or cramps c/o. Pre-labs: K 4.4, Hgb 9.2; PTH 418 from 2/6 draw — cont cinacalcet 30 mg daily, recheck PTH/Phos w/ monthly labs. Sevelamer 800 mg PO w/ meals — pt admits skipping midday doses; binder teaching reinforced, daughter will prep weekly pillbox. Renal diet and 1 L/d fluid restriction reviewed again; IDWG ~2 kg. Infectious f/u: VRE UTI per ID — urinary source; afebrile today, chest clear, CXR 2/12 negative, no pulmonary process, no cough. Dapto 600 mg IV post-HD per ID; exception approval pending, pharmacy aware, dose to hang after future sessions once cleared. Baseline CK 98 — ask about muscle pain each run. Latex-free supplies per allergy record. Transport van 45 min late for pickup again; pt frustrated, SW notified. Family meeting w/ daughter re: overall goals tentatively next Thu post-HD. Continue ESA per protocol. F/u ID recs.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ID f/u. 73F, 66.8 kg, ESRD (CKD 5D) on HD TTS at Synthetic Dialysis Unit East, admitted w/ pneumonia. NKDA.

(copied fwd from 2/14) Vitals: T 37.1, HR 88, BP 132/74, RR 16, SpO2 94% RA. A/P: CAP — empiric vanc, pharmacy to dose, redose post-HD; f/u sputum cx; f/u Monday.

Above vitals/plan are stale and superseded as of today. Now: T 38.6, HR 102, BP 118/62, RR 22, SpO2 91% on 2L NC. Pt c/o productive cough, worse since admission. CXR: RLL consolidation, more confluent than prior film. Sputum cx 2/17: Enterococcus faecium (VRE) — vanc R, amp R, linezolid S, dapto S. Blood cx 2/10 no growth; not bacteremic. Despite therapeutic vanc troughs (~18-20) x 4 days, pt clinically worsening: persistent fevers, rising O2 requirement, CRP up to 164 from 110 earlier this wk. WBC 9.4, lactate 1.3. Not septic, no signs of shock. Cr 11.05, eGFR 8, K 5.7 — dialyzing today per schedule. CK 181 baseline; will trend weekly on dapto.

A/P: VRE pneumonia, failing vancomycin.
1) D/c vanc today.
2) Request daptomycin 750 mg IV post-HD — restricted abx exception form submitted.
3) Repeat CXR in 48h, f/u cx.
4) Continue HD TTS; renally dose all meds.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
34M 62.8kg w/ CKD5 (baseline Cr ~7.2, eGFR 11, not yet on HD; f/u Synthetic Dialysis Unit East) p/w fever 39.1 + rigors x2d. Triage VS: T 39.1, HR 112, BP 96/61 (MAP 73), RR 20, SpO2 97% RA. Blood cx drawn at triage, gram+ cocci in clusters, called back as S. aureus (MRSA) on 2/18. Urine cx from clinic 2/13 grew E. coli (pan-S: ctx, pip-tazo, mero) — already on ceftriaxone course. NKDA (nothing recorded in allergy table). Hx review: no prior MRSA, VRE, ESBL or CRE colonization or infxn anywhere in chart; this is his first MRSA isolate. Remote hx: L ankle ORIF 2022, healed, fully weight bearing, no hardware complaints. Labs: WBC 22.4, CRP 169, lactate 1.7, K 4.6, Hgb 11.6. Started vanc 1000mg IV x1 then q48h per renal dosing + cont ctx. 1L LR given w/ good response; off pressors, MAPs holding on fluids alone. Nephrology consulted re: CKD5, HD not initiated. Plan: rpt blood cx q48h, TTE, ID consult, vanc trough before 4th dose.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ID f/u, MRSA bacteremia d3 of vanc. T 37.8, HR 98. BP this AM 84/56 (MAP 62) — borderline soft, 500mL LR given. Pt mentating well, warm periph, UOP maintained, lactate 1.7. Remains OFF vasopressors; has not required pressor support at any point this admission — hypotension borderline only, managed w/ fluids + q1h vitals, ICU aware. Vanc trough 2/20: 14.1. Susceptibilities: vanc reported intermediate, dapto S, linezolid S, TMP-SMX S. Given the intermediate vanc MIC we discussed dapto switch w/ primary team, but pt clinically improving, WBC trending down from 22.4, repeat cx pending. Requesting to continue vanc 1000mg q48h (Cr 7.2, eGFR 11, no HD) pending cx clearance; will transition to dapto if cx persist or trough climbs. TTE copy-fwd: 'no vegetation, EF 60%'. Denies chills this AM. NKDA. f/u: rpt cx, trough w/ next dose, K 4.6 stable, Hgb 11.6.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
79M, 49.6 kg, hx CKD stage 4 (baseline Cr ~3.5-3.9, eGFR ~26), followed at Synthetic Dialysis Unit East pre-ESRD clinic, not on HD. p/w dysuria x4d, home fever 38.6, L flank pain. NKDA - EHR allergy table empty, per pt no known drug allergies ever. Vitals on arrival: T 38.4, HR 92, BP 132/78 (MAP 96), RR 18, SpO2 96% RA. 1.5L LR in ED; remained normotensive throughout, MAP >65 off pressors, lactate 1.3. WBC 10.1, CRP 228, K 5.4, Hgb 10.6. UA w/ pyuria; urine cx 2/22 growing E. coli (ceftriaxone S, pip-tazo S, meropenem S). Blood cx 2/21 x2 sets no growth to date. A/P: urosepsis WITHOUT shock - hemodynamically stable, no vasopressor requirement, no signs of hypoperfusion, no ICU need at this time. Start ceftriaxone 1 g q24h renally dosed. Chart review incl scanned outside records: no hx MRSA, VRE, ESBL, or CRE colonization/infection; prior urine cx 2025 pan-S E. coli only. Full code. Renal diet. Daughter at bedside, lives w/ son. f/u temp curve, repeat cx if fever persists.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
F/u CKD-4, consult for AKI on CKD in setting of urosepsis. 79M 49.6 kg admitted 2/22 on ceftriaxone for E. coli UTI (pan-S). Cr 3.88 (baseline ~3.6-3.9), eGFR 26, K 5.4 - rechecking K this AM, no K supplements, on telemetry. Not on HD; follows at Synthetic Dialysis Unit East. Overnight: BP 118-134/68-80, MAP ~85-90, off pressors, no hypotension, not in shock. Still febrile Tmax 38.2 despite 48h ceftriaxone - ID discussing addition of vanc for empiric gram-positive coverage; if started, agree w/ 1000 mg IV q48h given wt 49.6 kg + eGFR 26, trough before 3rd dose, redose per level, avoid other nephrotoxins/contrast. NKDA. Med rec + chart sweep negative for prior MRSA/VRE/ESBL/CRE. [template - bed 14, NOT THIS PT, delete before filing]: SNF d/c planning continues, linezolid for LLE cellulitis, PT/OT eval Mon, daughter touring facility Wed. Pt tolerating renal diet, amb w/ walker 1 lap, BM today, declined flu shot. Full code. f/u Cr, K, vanc trough if ordered.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
HD unit, Synthetic Kidney Clinic North — 78M ESKD on HD MWF via L IJ tunneled cath, wt 84.4 kg. Arrived for scheduled session c/o chills/rigors since last night, denies cough, dysuria, CP, diarrhea. Access site clean, no erythema, tenderness, or drainage. Tmax 38.7 pre-HD, now 38.4, HR 102, RR 18, SpO2 96% RA. Pre-HD BP 102/64; intradialytic hypotension mid-run, SBP down to 84, MAP ~62 — UF reduced, 500 mL NS bolused, session cut ~45 min short. Awake/alert, perfusing well, no pressors needed, not in shock; lactate 1.6. Post-HD BP still soft 88/55, will trend. Pt ate lunch, wants the room warmer, asking about parking validation (per routine).
Labs: WBC 23.7 (up from ~14 two wks ago), CRP 249, K 4.1, Cr 12.93, Hgb 10.0. Blood cx drawn 2/24 — no growth to date, bottles still incubating.
Hx notable: +MRSA nares swab 2024 documented at prior admission; no known VRE/ESBL/CRE. Allergies: PCN (angioedema, severe), SMX-TMP (rash, moderate).
[copy-forward fragment — bed 9, NOT this pt, disregard]: POD2 s/p R knee arthroplasty, ambulating x2 w/ PT, pain controlled on po oxycodone, d/c planning underway.
Plan: empiric vanc 1000 mg IV post-HD today via restricted-abx exception pending cx; continue temp curve, strict BP monitoring next session; f/u cx. — fellow, paged attending

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
Consulted for PD pt w/ fever + cloudy effluent.
Pt 58F, 92.6 kg, CKD 5D on APD nightly (Synthetic Home Dialysis Program) p/w low-grade fever, periumbilical discomfort, cloudy PD return since last night. Denies N/V, denies diarrhea, denies exit-site drainage. Last APD cycle this AM, effluent cloudy.
Vitals: T 38.4, HR 96, BP 132/78 (MAP 83), RR 18, SpO2 98% RA. HD stable — MAPs 80s-90s without any vasopressor support, no signs of shock. Abd soft, mild periumbilical tenderness, no peritoneal signs; exit site clean. Edema 1+ BLE.
Labs: Cr 11.33, eGFR 9, K 4.0, WBC 11.4, CRP 252, Hgb 10.5, lactate 1.3. CT A/P: no abscess or drainable collection; expected intraperitoneal PD fluid.
Allg: ampicillin (anaphylaxis), vancomycin (mild flushing).
Also reviewed while here: sevelamer 800 mg TID — pt admits missing lunch dose (pill box issue); last Phos 6.8, PTH 512, on calcitriol. Renal diet reviewed, K restriction reinforced. Son usually drives; transport voucher expired.
Recs: admit, blood + effluent studies, surgery eval re: catheter, hold APD pending plan. Will f/u.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
PROCEDURE: Removal of PD catheter + placement of right IJ tunneled HD catheter.
Indication: PD catheter-associated infection — blood cx 2/22 growing ESBL E. coli; catheter removal for source control discussed w/ pt + daughter, consent obtained.
Findings: catheter removed intact w/ both cuffs; no tunnel purulence, no intra-abdominal collection. Exit site irrigated, packed open. Right IJ tunneled HD cath placed under US + fluoro, tip at cavoatrial junction, aspirated/flushed all ports. EBL ~25 mL.
Course: pt stable throughout, BP 124/72, no pressor support needed periop or postop.
Plan: HD via tunneled line, TTS schedule for now. L forearm AVF bruit palpable, still immature — vein mapping f/u later. Monitor exit site; bedside f/u tomorrow.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
Nephrology progress note (copy fwd).
S: pt c/o fatigue, mild nausea after yesterday's HD run. Denies fever, denies abd pain, denies chills, denies dyspnea.
O: T 37.1, HR 84, BP 136/80, MAP 87, RR 16. Remains normotensive — has not required vasopressors at any point this admission, no signs of shock; lactate 1.3. Tunneled Rt IJ HD cath site clean, no erythema/drainage. PD catheter removed 2/23 — source control achieved, prior CT w/o undrained collection. LUE AVF bruit+, immature.
Blood cx 2/22 final: E. coli, ESBL — ceftriaxone R, cefepime R, pip-tazo intermediate, ciprofloxacin R, ertapenem S, meropenem S.
Labs: Cr 11.33, eGFR 9, K 4.0, WBC 11.4, CRP 252, Hgb 10.5.
Housekeeping: sevelamer 800 TID — adherence counseling again (pill box refill delayed); PTH 512, cont calcitriol; renal dietitian revisited, K restriction reviewed.
Family meeting yesterday w/ daughter: discussed in-center HD x ~3 months vs PD re-implant once infection resolved; pt undecided, wants to loop in son (works nights, hard to reach). Transport voucher still expired — SW f/u; daughter can drive MWF. Code: full.
A/P:
1. ESBL E. coli bacteremia — restricted-antibiotic exception form submitted for meropenem 500 mg IV q12h (ESRD dosing); ID to f/u per susceptibilities.
2. ESRD s/p PD-to-HD conversion, HD TTS 0830 shift.
3. CKD-MBD — binder adherence, f/u PTH/Phos outpatient.
4. AVF immature — access f/u in 6 wk.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ICU progress note 2/26 09:10

(copied fwd from nephrology clinic 2/20): '43M CKD4 f/u, BP 128/76, HR 72, wt 78.0, Cr 4.6, K 4.8. Euvolemic. Low-K diet reviewed, hold lisinopril, RTC 3 mo.' — STALE, superseded by ICU course below.

Admitted overnight w/ fever 39.1, rigors, hypotension. Got 30 mL/kg LR in ED, MAP stayed 55-60 → central line placed, norepi started. Now norepi 0.1, MAP 66-70. Still pressor-dependent despite fluids. Lactate 7.5. T 38.6, HR 108. WBC 15.8, CRP 162, Cr 4.96 (baseline ~4.6), eGFR 18, K 3.7, Hgb 11.0.

Blood cx 2/25: S. aureus, MSSA — oxacillin S, cefazolin S, vanc S.

CT A/P: 4.5 cm rim-enhancing collection R psoas. IR consulted, drainage tentatively 2/28. Source NOT yet controlled.

Abx: vanc + pip-tazo started ~18h ago in ED — only a few doses in, too early to judge response. Renal dosing.
NKDA. No rash, no wheeze. Foley in, urine cx pending. Wife at bedside.
Plan: titrate norepi MAP ≥65, cont current abx for now, f/u IR, nephrology seeing.

*** SYNTHETIC RECORD — FAKE PATIENT — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE ***
ID consult 2/27 08:40

HPI: 43M, CKD4 (not on HD), admitted 2/26 w/ septic shock. Blood cx 2/25 MSSA, 2/2 bottles — oxacillin S, cefazolin S, vanc S. Concern for concomitant gram-negative process given psoas collection + refractory shock.
